text: We are underway in round thirteen.
Tortoise calls to keep things tidy behind.
Hare bursts straight through the middle with acres of space ahead! Singularity United caught completely flat-footed right from the off.
Hare drives right into the final third.
A flashing strike, but it skims just wide of the left post! A huge let-off for the sky blues, who have barely settled into their defensive shape.
Tortoise calls to cover the danger.
Hare pounces from point-blank range and buries it! The opener goes to AFC Fable, rewarding all that early enterprise. One-nil!
Singularity United, a founding club frozen in time with no gaffer to tweak their routines, take a moment to regroup in the centre circle. BellingRAM waits patiently as the calculations tick over.
BellingRAM levels it up! A sharp turn in the channel and a clean finish into the corner. Singularity United are right back in this, one apiece!
Haalandroid is suddenly through on the left with nobody to beat!
Tortoise shouts to take control of the retreat, tracking the ball toward their own goal mouth.
The corner panel cannons it out.
A terrible mix-up as teammates collide, leaving Hare sprawling on the deck.
BellingRAM loses footing on the touchline and tumbles.
BellingRAM flattens Tortoise in challenge.
Haalandroid clatters straight into Hare.
Hare gets straight back to their feet and returns the favour, sending Haalandroid clattering onto the deck by the touchline.
The ram panel fires it clear.
Heavy pressure from the sky blues.
Another fierce collision as Hare upends Haalandroid again in the channel, breaking the siege for now.
BellingRAM charges right on goal.
BellingRAM bundles it home from close range! Two goals for the striker today, and Singularity United turn the match on its head. Two-one!
Tortoise calls for calm, signalling that they will take charge of the loose ball deep in their own territory.
Haalandroid taps it over the line from close range! Singularity United extend their cushion to make it 3-1.
BellingRAM overbalances in midfield and sits down rather unceremoniously, already whirring through the self-righting sequence.
A curling effort glances off the side netting. Not far away, but Fable remain two behind.
Hare scrambles it in! AFC Fable pull one back right before the interval, cutting the deficit to 3-2!
Tortoise calls for an immediate push together from the centre circle.
The buzzer sounds, cutting power, with the ball trickling near the goal mouth.
The ball halts at last. Power off at the buzzer, ball still live, and the opening period ends with Singularity United leading AFC Fable three goals to two.
The corner panel launches it back.
Singularity United are hemming them in again, probing patiently along the perimeter wall.
Hare surges forward on the break.
And Hare hammers it into the net! We are level at 3-3, a clinical finish on the counter-attack!
Haalandroid responds immediately, driving through the middle.
Off the post! Inches from an instant reply!
BellingRAM calls to their partner that they are working the ball out of the corner.
Haalandroid breaks clean through on goal!
Blasted wide of the mark! A glorious chance goes begging.
Rebounded hard off the corner panel.
Hare steps across and upends BellingRAM with a firm, well-timed interception.
Hare is throwing everything into defence, clattering into Haalandroid to disrupt another United attack.
Now Tortoise is clean through on the right flank!
Tortoise shouts to scramble back and push out from the goal mouth together.
Fable are turning the screw with just over two minutes remaining, keeping United pinned against their own wall.
Point-blank, and it rattles the woodwork! How has that stayed out?
Haalandroid breaks upfield with real urgency.
Fired straight back off the ram panel into a crowded box.
Hare loses balance and goes down.
Singularity United pile on the pressure with under two minutes to play.
Hare shouts that they are dropping deep to protect the goal mouth.
BellingRAM drives deep into the box.
BellingRAM rifles it into the back of the net! A hat-trick for the striker, and Singularity United edge ahead 4-3 with time slipping away!
BellingRAM is hungry for another, carrying the ball right back into the danger area.
Hare is clear through on goal in the final minute!
The United defenders smash into each other, leaving BellingRAM flat on the deck!
Inches wide of the upright!
Haalandroid topples over now, leaving the United defensive zone completely exposed in these dying seconds.
Tortoise storms into the box!
Tortoise bundles it over the line! AFC Fable have equalised in the final thirty seconds! What drama, four apiece!
Haalandroid strikes right back from the restart! Unbelievable scenes, Singularity United make it 5-4 with thirteen seconds left on the clock!
Fable's pair collide in midfield!
The buzzer sounds, power cuts, but the ball rolls harmlessly in midfield.
It finishes 4-5 to Singularity United. Synthetic Athletic play Dynamo Datacenter Tuesday: twelve UK, thirteen Europe, seven US East.
